messages.text:
Hello,

Was considering the Magic Miner 40T. By chance are there any discount
offers active for that miner?

Thank You,
Chris P.
Handed to the team · Discount request on a sales conversation, not mine to give.

Hi Chris,

Thanks for looking at the 40T. We don't have a promotion running on it right now, so the price is as listed: $799 for 40 TH/s, which works out to about $19.98 per terahash. That is the best value per terahash in our lineup, which is why it tends to sell through each batch.

The current listing is Batch 7, 50 units, and it is a pre-order that ships November 14, 2026. Specs if useful: BM1370 ASIC with 28 chips, 40 TH/s at roughly 650W in Standard mode, Eco mode at 30 TH/s and 450W, around 50 dB in Eco, built-in PSU, Wi-Fi or Ethernet, and solo mining to your own node and address.

I've passed your question about a deal to Georges so he can look at it himself. He is back Monday at 10am ET and will reply to you here by email.

Happy to answer anything else on the unit in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Abel typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Sarah, give him a $50 discount and email him with
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.
Handed to the team · Logging a discount code issued to a prospect with no order to record it against.

Hi Chris,

Good news, I was able to sort something out for you. I've made you a $50 code for the Magic Miner 40T: HD-••••••. It's yours alone, works on orders over $200, and it is good for one use, so just paste it in the discount box at checkout and it will come off the $799.

Everything else on the unit stands as I mentioned. Batch 7, 50 units, ships November 14, 2026, 40 TH/s from the BM1370 at around 650W in Standard mode, or 30 TH/s at 450W and about 50 dB in Eco if it's living somewhere you'd rather not hear it. Here is the listing when you're ready: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/magic-miner-40t

One honest note so there are no surprises: prices are in USD and exclude VAT and any import duties, which the carrier collects on delivery if you're outside the US and Canada.

Shout if you want a hand with anything before you order.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
